import sklearn.datasets
import sklearn.model_selection
import sklearn.ensemble

X, y = sklearn.datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)

rs = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3, 4, 5]}
)
rs.fit(X, y)
print("fit_time", rs.cv_results_['mean_fit_time'])
print("score_time", rs.cv_results_['mean_score_time'])

# n_jobs != 1

)
rs2.fit(X, y)
print("randomized refit_time_", rs2.refit_time_)
assert rs2.refit_time_ >= 0

# refit=False should not have refit_time_
rs3 = sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV(
    estimator=sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier(),
    param_grid={'n_estimators': [2, 3]}, refit=False
)
rs3.fit(X, y)
assert not hasattr(rs3, 'refit_time_')
print("OK")

# 1. multimetric refit (refit specified as scorer name)

                  {'n_estimators': [2, 3]},

gs.fit(X, y)
print('multimetric refit_time_ =', gs.refit_time_)

gs2.fit(X, y)
